Class SocketServerHandler

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am14.network.socket.client.SocketServerHandler
All Implemented Interfaces:
VirtualServerSocket, VirtualServer
public class SocketServerHandler extends Object implements VirtualServerSocket
Handles outgoing socket communication from the client to the server. Implements VirtualServerSocket to act as a proxy, serializing client actions into JSON requests and dispatching them through the output streams.
